mapper.sql: c.cart_item_id,c.member_id,c.sku_id,c.quantity,c.selected_flag, s.sku_code,s.sku_name,p.product_name,coalesce(s.image_url,p.main_image) product_image,s.price, coalesce(st.available_quantity,s.available_stock) available_stock,s.status sku_status,s.del_flag sku_del_flag, p.publish_status spu_publish_status,p.del_flag spu_del_flag
mapper.select: select from mall_cart_item c left join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=c.sku_id left join mall_spu p on p.spu_id=s.spu_id left join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=s.sku_id where c.member_id=#{memberId} order by c.cart_item_id desc

select from mall_cart_item c left join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=c.sku_id left join mall_spu p on p.spu_id=s.spu_id left join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=s.sku_id where c.member_id=#{memberId} and c.sku_id=#{skuId} for update

select null cart_item_id,null member_id, s.sku_id,1 quantity,'0' selected_flag, s.sku_code,s.sku_name,p.product_name,coalesce(s.image_url,p.main_image) product_image,s.price, coalesce(st.available_quantity,s.available_stock) available_stock,s.status sku_status,s.del_flag sku_del_flag, p.publish_status spu_publish_status,p.del_flag spu_del_flag from mall_sku s left join mall_spu p on p.spu_id=s.spu_id left join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=s.sku_id where s.sku_id=#{skuId}
mapper.update: update mall_cart_item set quantity=#{quantity},update_time=now() where member_id=#{memberId} and sku_id=#{skuId}
update mall_cart_item set selected_flag=#{selectedFlag},update_time=now() where member_id=#{memberId} and sku_id=#{skuId}
mapper.delete: delete from mall_cart_item where member_id=#{memberId} and sku_id=#{skuId}
